task: Review these screenshots (paths relative to the workspace root): design_review/home.png, design_review/catalog.png, design_review/product.png, design_review/thanks.png. Open each one with Read and judge the visual design as described in your instructions.
output:
I attempted to pull real design-system values via Figma MCP but the session tool call wasn't granted permission, so the verdict below is based on direct visual inspection against the `frontend-design` skill's guidance rather than confirmed token values.

## Home (`home.png`)
- **Category cards are the generic "SaaS-card kit" the skill explicitly flags**: four identical white rounded cards, same radius, same soft shadow, same icon-in-a-box treatment, regardless of which category they represent. Nothing differentiates "Трубы и фитинги" (2 товара) from the others structurally — it's decoration, not information.
- **Icons read as placeholder/generated, not a chosen icon set.** The "Смесители" card icon is a stylized letter "F" — it doesn't communicate "faucet" at a glance and breaks consistency with the other three, which are at least literal (pipe, toilet, water heater).
- **Huge dead whitespace below the fold.** Content (hero + 4 cards) ends roughly a third of the way down a ~900px viewport; the rest is blank gray before the footer. This reads unfinished rather than deliberate — needs either a contained/shorter page shell or more content (e.g., a value-prop strip, contact/trust block) to stop the page floating in empty space.
- **Typography has no real personality.** Heading, subhead, and body all appear to be the same default system sans at different sizes/weights — there's a size hierarchy but no typographic point of view (per the skill: "typography carries the personality of the page").
- Palette (dark teal + orange accent) is a reasonable, non-generic choice for a plumbing/hardware business — keep that.

## Catalog (`catalog.png`)
- Only 2 of what looks like a multi-column grid is populated, leaving roughly 60% of the row as dead space to the right. The grid should either cap its track count to content or constrain max-width so a short product list doesn't look broken/empty.
- Price ("350.00 сом") is bold teal against a lighter-weight title — good, this hierarchy works.
- Placeholder product image (gray-blue box with centered pipe-wrench icon) is consistent with the home page icon style, but the icon floats small and centered in a disproportionately large box — same "token icon in empty field" issue as home.

## Product detail (`product.png`)
- The placeholder image block is oversized relative to its content — a small centered icon inside a tall gray rectangle, producing a lot of dead visual weight on the left side.
- **Stock badge ("В наличии: 120 шт.") is a flat gray chip with dark gray text** — low contrast and no semantic color. This is availability/positive information and should use a success/green treatment (the project's Figma library is described as having a "Success Badge" component — this is exactly where it should be used instead of a neutral gray pill).
- Right column (title, price, description, badge, form) doesn't fill the vertical space matched by the image column, leaving an unbalanced composition — lots of blank area to the bottom-right of the fold.
- The "Оставить заявку" form itself is clean: left teal accent border, clear label-above-input pattern, orange CTA button consistent with the brand accent. No complaints there.

## Thanks (`thanks.png`)
- This page works well: centered confirmation card, green check circle, green left-accent border matching the success state, clear message with the actual order details interpolated in, two low-friction next actions. Appropriately restrained for a confirmation screen — no changes needed here.

VISUAL: FAIL

Fixes, in priority order:
1. Differentiate the four home category cards instead of using identical rounded-card-with-shadow treatment for all — vary at least the icon style/weight so each category is visually legible, and replace the "Смесители" letter-F icon with an actual faucet glyph.
2. Fix the stock badge on the product page to use a success/green style (not a gray neutral chip) so "в наличии" reads as positive status at a glance.
3. Close the dead-space gap on home (page ends ~1/3 down the viewport) — either constrain the page shell height/background or add a content block (value props, service area, trust signals) so the layout doesn't float in empty gray space.
4. On catalog, cap the grid's max-width or column count so a 2-item category doesn't leave a large empty block to the right of the cards.
5. Rebalance the product-detail layout — shrink/resize the placeholder image box so it isn't a large mostly-empty rectangle, and bring the right column's content height closer to the image column so the two sides read as one composed layout rather than two independently sized blocks.
